title: WWT ↔ U.S. Army Signal Mapping
description: World Wide Technology public content and Army business, set next to U.S. Army leadership priorities.
readFirst: Covers Nov. 3–12. No WWT newsroom release dated Nov. 11–12 was found. A Nov. 10 WWT blog describes the company's Microsoft Ignite booth and is commercial, not Army work. Illumio's Nov. 10 note that it will be featured in WWT's ARMOR framework is not Army or U.S. federal work, so it was not added. A Nov. 11 WWT podcast on AI token costs was not added. The Nov. 4 InfiniteAI program remains the newest press release. The mapping subsection is empty.
